summary: Banco Santander's Form 6-K half-yearly report discloses two transactions: the completed acquisition of TSB from Sabadell for ~GBP 2.9bn (~EUR 3.3bn) cash, closing 30 April 2026 after regulatory approvals, and the announced acquisition of 100% of Webster Financial Corporation for USD 12.2bn (~EUR 10.3bn), approved by Webster shareholders in May 2026, pending customary conditions and regulatory approvals. The TSB acquisition was funded with cash, impacting CET1 by -55bp. No advisor named. Wait for Webster regulatory clearance and closing. Risk-arb: monitor antitrust and banking approvals timeline.
